profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI Platform Leadership | SaaS Platform Architecture
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with 10+ years of experience across software, AV systems, and networking. Today, I focus on SaaS platform architecture, full-stack development, and AI platform leadership.

I own Vantage Portal, an AV monitoring and management SaaS platform, from architecture and development through production operations and ongoing improvement. Alongside that work, I lead AI platform initiatives.

My AV and infrastructure background shapes how I approach engineering: connect business needs to technical decisions, design for real-world use, and build reliable, maintainable systems. I enjoy taking practical ideas from concept to production and improving them as people use them.

positions.description:
